source.title: The human brain is intrinsically organized into dynamic, anticorrelated functional networks
source.venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

confidence_rationale: The single strongest available argument for ARC-084's NON-DEGENERACY precondition, which is the part of the claim most at risk. Anticorrelation between two distributed networks is observed at REST, in the absence of any task, decision or selection -- so at least at the macroscale, a negative relationship between fields is an intrinsic organisational property and not a residue of a running selection softmax. That is exactly the dissociation ARC-084 needs and cannot get from the local-competition literature. Held to 0.55 by two serious discounts: the global signal regression controversy (see summary) and the fact that a statistical anticorrelation between BOLD time-series is not a demonstrated generative coupling with its own gain, precision, gate and timescale -- it is one scalar where ARC-084 posits eight fields.
failure_signatures: Fox et al. applied global signal regression; Murphy et al. 2009 (PMID 18976716) showed mathematically that after global signal regression correlations to a seed voxel must sum to a negative value, and concluded that global signal regression is most likely the cause of the anticorrelations. If that is right, the field-level negative sign is a preprocessing artefact and this entry's support for ARC-084 evaporates.

A BOLD anticorrelation is a symmetric statistical relationship. ARC-084 asserts a typed edge carrying sign, gain, precision, gate, timescale and write_authority as independently manipulable parameters. Observing the sign does not evidence the other seven, and an architecture justified by this finding alone would be over-specified relative to its evidence.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Analysis of spontaneous BOLD fluctuations in the resting human brain revealed two diametrically opposed, widely distributed networks: regions correlated positively within each network and anticorrelated between networks. One network comprised regions routinely showing task-related activations, the other regions routinely showing task-related deactivations. This organisation was present without overt task performance.
mapping.ree_translation: Supports ARC-084's central representational commitment that the SIGN of coupling between two fields is a first-class property of the architecture rather than a by-product of selection. The critical feature for REE is not that competition exists -- MECH-090, ARC-030 and MECH-254 already give V3 local competition -- but that the negative relationship is present at rest, with no decision being made and no selection softmax running. An emergent-from-selection account has to explain why the resting architecture is organised around a negative sign at all.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Macroscale human fMRI, transferred to a V4 cognifold field-coupling layer that does not exist. Two boundaries the claim's own CAUTIONS demand be kept: this is not synaptic inhibition, and an anticorrelated edge here is not pathological or ethically negative -- it is the healthy resting organisation. Further, resting-state anticorrelation is contested as a preprocessing artefact (see failure_signatures), and correlation-based connectivity is undirected, so it evidences a sign but not a source->target edge.
mapping.source_context: Human; resting-state BOLD fMRI; spontaneous low-frequency fluctuations; seed-based functional connectivity.

confidence_components.notes: One of the most-cited papers in human functional imaging, but source quality is docked from ceiling because its central claim is the one the global-signal-regression literature specifically contests. Mapping fidelity at 0.50: it evidences one of the eight fields ARC-084's edge specifies, and undirected at that.
